nodes.summary: The infinite product over all natural numbers $m \ge 0$ of $\frac{(4m+2)^2}{(4m+1)(4m+3)}$ converges unconditionally to $\sqrt{2}$; that is, $\frac{2 \cdot 2}{1 \cdot 3} \cdot \frac{6 \cdot 6}{5 \cdot 7} \cdot \frac{10 \cdot 10}{9 \cdot 11} \cdots = \sqrt{2}$.
